{{Quote|I don't believe the Tenloss Syndicate knows that Ororo is trying to take over our spice operations in that sector.|Xizor|<ref name="SotE novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Ororo Transportation''' was a semi-legitimate shipping company. It was actually a member of the criminal [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]], posing as its business partner.<ref name="GG11" /><ref name="Guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Its chief operating officer was [[Tuyay]], its chief of security was [[Dellis Yuls]], and its chief financial officer was [[Z. Limmer]].

[[Vergesso Base]] was a [[shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] controlled by Ororo. [[Nim Zanti]] was an Ororo lieutenant assigned to the Base during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Guide" />

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was concerned about cooperating with Ororo and using its [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] base. However the Alliance was desperate for any outside assistance, such as the facilities the Base provided; after a quick investigation they discovered only a business connection to Tenloss, and proceeded to the uneasy alliance.<ref name="Guide" />

Nobody knew that Tenloss sometimes used the base as a slave transfer point, and Ororo did not want to lose the alliance with the Rebels should this operation was uncovered.<ref name="Guide" /> Ororo was ready to send [[Natori Association|Natori]] guards (another front of Tenloss, providing security to the base) to execute any slavers discovered, essentially as a punishment for their incompetence. Publicly, Ororo would pretend that the slavery incident was isolated, and temporarily halt the operations, feigning tighter security to "prevent" this.<Ref name="raid">{{WEGCite|story=Slave Raid|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

Ororo was a competitor of [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]], secretly trying to take over [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun's]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] operations in the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]]. This incurred [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] wrath as he had his aide [[Guri]] [[Death/Legends|murder]] Ororo's top executives while he convinced [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards|destroy]] an Ororo shipyard by telling the Emperor that it was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base (a claim that was at least partially true as the shipyard housed hundreds of rebel ships and a number of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]), dealing a severe financial blow to Ororo as punishment.
